content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Selling digital products such as ebooks, templates, and courses is a lucrative venture for many creators. However, the barriers imposed by payment processors can severely limit access to potential revenue streams. Solana payments provide a viable alternative, allowing creators to sell their products directly to consumers without incurring hefty fees. For example, while Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, NOWPayments only takes 0.5%. This substantial fee difference can mean significant savings, as seen when processing 100 sales per month on a $97 product, where the fee difference retains $921 for the creator.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture for Solana payments integrates several components that work seamlessly together. The digital product is hosted on a platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, where creators can easily upload and manage their products. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is processed through NOWPayments, which verifies the transaction on the Solana blockchain. This method ensures that creators receive their payments in cryptocurrency instantly, eliminating the need for traditional banking processes and reducing transaction costs, thereby enhancing the overall profitability of digital sales.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions with restricted access to conventional payment platforms. It empowers artists, authors, and entrepreneurs to monetize their skills and products without relying on third-party services that charge exorbitant fees or impose limitations. By utilizing Solana payments, creators can maintain full control over their sales and customer data, ensuring a secure and sovereign commerce experience. This model fosters financial independence and supports a decentralized approach to digital commerce, which is particularly crucial in unstable economic environments.
Eliminate platform fees and keep more of your earnings with Solana payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective deployment of Solana payments relies on a combination of various components. Creators begin with a hosting service, followed by integrating backend solutions like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order management. NOWPayments serves as the payment processor, allowing cryptocurrency transactions and offering a diverse range of supported coins. By storing product files on platforms like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, creators can ensure secure and efficient delivery to customers. Together, these components create a robust digital commerce stack that facilitates seamless transactions and enhances user experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To leverage Solana payments for your digital products, start by setting up your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, create a payment integration with NOWPayments, ensuring you configure the necessary API keys to enable cryptocurrency transactions. After that, upload your products for sale, and set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Finally, promote your digital products and watch as customers can purchase them effortlessly with crypto, allowing you to enjoy the benefits of lower fees and greater financial sovereignty.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can leverage cryptocurrency payment solutions like NOWPayments. This platform allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, ensuring you retain more of your earnings. By utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can build an online store that operates independently of traditional payment processors, giving you complete control over your sales.
Retain full ownership and control of your digital products and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I accept payments in cryptocurrency?
You can accept cryptocurrency payments by integrating NOWPayments into your digital store. This service processes payments securely, allowing customers to pay with various cryptocurrencies.
What are the costs associated with using Solana payments?
The primary cost is the transaction fee charged by NOWPayments, which is only 0.5%. This is significantly lower than other platforms, such as Gumroad, which takes 10% per sale.
Can I sell multiple types of digital products?
Yes, you can sell a variety of digital products like ebooks, courses, templates, and software using the same infrastructure. This flexibility allows you to diversify your offerings.
Is there any technical skill required to set this up?
While some technical knowledge can be helpful, the process is designed to be user-friendly. Comprehensive documentation is available to guide you through setup and integration.
What if I need support after deployment?
Upon purchasing the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, you will receive 30 days of support to assist you with any issues or questions about your setup.
